text: [ffff64]*Proceed to the epilogue of White Day Quest:\n"Baking Is Battle"?[ffffff]
Yeah, I know what to do!
By the way, Lefina...\nYou didn't change the ingredients again this time,\ndid you...?
D-don't worry!\nWe prepared them together and you were there the\nwhole time, weren't you?
...Can I really trust you...?\nYou didn't secretly add something while I wasn't\nlooking, right...?
You're being really annoying right now!\nI swear to God, I didn't do anything weird this\ntime!
Maybe I should have added something to the\nmixture...
?? Did you just say something?\nIt's behaving properly and everything is perfectly\nunder control, right?
What?! What on earth is going on?!
Hahahahaha!!\nSo that's the monster you created, huh!?\nYou'd better hand it over to me!!
How dare you…\nThat's not gonna happen!!
I knew you wouldn't hand it over to me so easily.\nBut, do you think it can beat the Mycodian\nI created?
W-What's going on?!\nStop!\nDo as I say!!
...Maybe fighting that monster made it lose\ncontrol...
Hmph. Looks like it was a flop!\nWell, whatever, I was gonna use this Mycodian to\ntake it and the little brat by force anyway.
...W-we need to do something...\nAnd we can't just leave on our own because\nVelcaroy could be stolen while we're gone...!
I do have one, but we need to calm them down\nfirst...
Lefina...!\nThis is an emergency. Let's unleash the power of\nsweets!
We'll find a way to stop Velcaroy and\nneutralize it...! You and Pelulu, please take care\nof that monster...!
Ugh, I guess we have no choice now!\nYou take care of it!
Grr!\nIf you're gonna get in my way, I'll show you no\nmercy!!
Dammit! I failed to get my hands on that precious\nspecimen again this time.\nBut I'll never give up!!
Looks like we somehow managed to pull through\nonce again...
We simply can't let our guard down even for a\nsecond. Especially this time, I thought we had\neverything completely under control.
...Indeed...\nThere's no time for experiments now.\nLet's head back to town for now...
That Libarza guy really picked the perfect\nmoment...I mean, it was truly awful of him to\nattack us at a moment like that...
No, nothing...\nAnyway, thank you very much for your help.\nHere's your reward...
Whateverrr~! Next time just make normal sweets!
